checks.criterion: Customer stories section is visible on mobile
checks.name: customer-stories-visible-no-counter
checks.evidence: On 390x844 mobile viewport, 'WORN. LOVED. RETURNED TO.' section renders directly after WHY SHOP SAFYRA (index check whyIdx visible), quote text ('Hey Afira! I'm here flaunting...'), first name 'Rashmi', and city 'HIMACHAL PRADESH' are all visible (not blank). No numerical counter (regex /\d\s*\/\s*5/) found in section text. Screenshots initial-story.png, quote-name-city.png.

checks.criterion: Customer story remains visible after auto-rotation
checks.name: customer-story-auto-rotates
checks.evidence: Captured section snapshot showing Rashmi/HIMACHAL PRADESH story, then waited (page.waitForFunction, up to 8s) for section innerText to change without any interaction. Section auto-advanced to 'Dr Manaswini / ODISHA' story (a genuine different customer, confirming ~5.5-6s auto-rotation works). Customer remained visible after rotation. Screenshots before-rotation.png, after-rotation.png.

checks.name: customer-carousel-stable-single-panel
checks.evidence: Section contains exactly 1 at a time (imgCount=1, not a multi-item strip). Clicking data-testid='customer-love-next' changed the story (verified innerText diff); clicking data-testid='customer-love-previous' returned to the original story text exactly. Section height measured before/after (1064px -> 1064px, diff=0, well under 40px threshold) confirming no layout jump. No '/ n' numerical counter present in any state. Screenshots panel-before-next.png, panel-after-next.png, panel-after-prev.png.

summary: 3/3 acceptance criteria covered via 3 new browser checks (customer-stories-visible-no-counter, customer-story-auto-rotates, customer-carousel-stable-single-panel), all run against the live preview URL on a 390x844 mobile viewport: 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky, 0 blocked, 0 test_error. No pure-API surface for these criteria (client-side rendering/rotation logic), so no backend test files were required. Prior check 'customer-carousel-navigation-and-autoadvance' (iteration 7) referenced a '1 / 5' style counter that has since been intentionally removed per this briefing's third criterion; it is left in place as a historical artifact but is superseded by the new checks and no longer represents current expected behavior. No bugs found, no action items, no retest needed.
